'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**[[March 2025 United States attacks in Yemen]]
***The [[Houthi]] health ministry announces that the death toll from yesterday's strikes by the [[U.S.]] in [[Yemen]] rose to 53, with 98 injured. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cedle6je601o.amp (BBC)]
**The Houthis claim that they targeted {{Ship|USS|Harry S. Truman}} with 18 rockets and [[drone warfare|drones]]. No damage has been reported. [https://www.aljazeera.net/news/2025/3/16/%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%AC%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%AF%D8%AB-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%B3%D9%83%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B3%D9%85-%D8%A3%D9%86%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%84%D9%87-3 (Al Jazeera Arabic)]
*[[Insurgency in Balochistan]]
**Eleven people are killed and 21 more are injured in a [[Suicide attack|suicide bombing]] targeting a [[Frontier Corps]] convoy on a highway in [[Nushki]], [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]]. The [[Balochistan Liberation Army]] claims responsibility, claiming they killed 90 [[Pakistan Armed Forces|security personnel]]. [https://www.indiatoday.in/world/story/pakistan-military-convoy-attacked-baloch-insurgents-claim-90-killed-2694202-2025-03-16 (''India Today'')] [https://www.wionews.com/south-asia/major-explosion-near-convoy-in-balochistans-noshki-in-pakistan-8858248 (WION)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Kočani nightclub fire]]
**At least 59 people are killed and more than 152 others are injured after a fire breaks out in a nightclub during a concert in [[Kočani]], [[North Macedonia]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/3/16/at-least-51-people-killed-in-nightclub-fire-in-north-macedonia (Al Jazeera)] 
*[[Tornado outbreak of March 13–16, 2025]]
**The death toll from the [[tornado]]es across several [[States of the United States|states]] in the U.S. increases to 40. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/live-updates/tornado-outbreak-live-updates-18-dead-dozens-injured/?id=119832914 (ABC News)]
*At least 16 people are killed and 18 others are injured when an [[unexploded ordnance]] from the [[Syrian civil war]] explodes and causes a building to collapse in [[Latakia]], [[Latakia Governorate]], [[Syria]]. [https://apnews.com/article/syria-lattakia-ordnance-explosion-mines-white-helmets-84bdc4b9d11ea38d662829cf3259eb39 (AP)] [https://www.dw.com/en/at-least-16-people-dead-in-blast-from-suspected-old-bomb-in-syria/a-71934830 (DW)]
*The [[Wilhelminatoren|Wilhelmina Tower]] in [[Valkenburg aan de Geul|Valkenburg]], [[Netherlands]], built in 1906 and designated a [[Rijksmonument]], collapses. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2559802-wilhelminatoren-ingestort-in-valkenburg-oorzaak-onbekend (NOS)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[United States President]] [[Donald Trump]] signs an [[executive order]] shutting down multiple state-funded broadcasters, including [[Voice of America]], [[Radio y Televisión Martí]] and [[Alhurra]], and ceasing grants to [[Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty]] and [[Radio Free Asia]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2025-03-16/voice-of-america-radio-free-asia-us-funding-cut/105058080 (ABC News Australia)] [https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/trump-signs-order-gut-voice-america-other-agencies-2025-03-15/ (Reuters)]
